gadget_plan.mathematical_rationale: The gadget uses two auxiliary variables forced to true and false by target-1 all-same and target-0 all-same respectively. Then each of the three pairwise output pairs is connected via the target-1 relation with constants (true,false,false), which is exactly XOR. The three XOR constraints enforce that the three outputs are pairwise distinct, which is equivalent to exactly one being true. Thus the gadget exactly realizes the one-in-three relation.
